name: ninjapaws-hq
description: Ninja Paws public consulting and professional services site.

scripts.config:check: node scripts/deploy-config.mjs --environment dev --check && node scripts/deploy-config.mjs --environment prod --check
scripts.infra:build: az bicep build --file infra/main.bicep --outfile .bicep-out/main.json && az bicep build --file infra/azure/site/main.bicep --outfile .bicep-out/site.json && az bicep build-params --file infra/azure/site/main.dev.bicepparam --outfile .bicep-out/site.dev.parameters.json && az bicep build-params --file infra/azure/site/main.prod.bicepparam --outfile .bicep-out/site.prod.parameters.json
